headline: Saginaw Valley State finish top of the table
dek: Saginaw Valley State's one defeat on the record came at home to Northern Michigan in September, and they have not lost since. Roosevelt ended Purdue Northwest's run of wins on their own ground, then went back to the same ground and won there again.
displaced_by: Roosevelt won at Purdue Northwest again on 2026-11-13, so the standing dek's 'on the last day' no longer holds

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring is top-heavy: Northern Michigan alone have scored more than Davenport and St. Cloud State together.

wire.line: Saginaw Valley State take the table beaten only once, and that at home by Northern Michigan.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches whose dates have passed carry no published result, the earliest of them Northern Michigan's opening match against Green Bay.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Luca Rosen has scored sixteen goals from 78 shots for Northern Michigan.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Matty Telfer has scored thirteen of Saginaw Valley State's 34 goals, from 55 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Sergio Cano Castro, a freshman, has ten assists for Northern Michigan.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mateusz Pass has made 83 saves for Wisconsin-Parkside while conceding nineteen goals.

last_match.line: Northern Michigan have not won since beating Davenport in October.

next_match.line: Roosevelt have not lost since October; Lincoln held Saginaw Valley State to a draw in August.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
